title: Chanin bar Pinchas
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Sotah 4a on the measure of impurity: Rabbi Yehudah ben Beteira said… Rabbi Elazar ben Yirmeyah… Chanin bar Pinchas… and Pelimo. In Kiddushin 72a: “It was taught likewise: Chanin bar Pinchas says,” etc.[^1]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital Sotah 4a concerns the time sufficient for seclusion and explicitly names Rabbi Yehudah ben Beteira and Rabbi Elazar ben Yirmeyah, supporting both abbreviations. It has Chanin ben Pinchas, while Kiddushin 72a has Chanan ben Pinchas; Hyman’s bar Pinchas form is retained.
